text.offer: Luisane d'Ile says, "There is a Temple of Jala here in Berg. Jala is the goddess of song, and her priestess, Themala, teaches her magic to anyone with an ear for it: songs that lift your friends and wear down your enemies. Go and hear her. You won't regret it."
text.progress: The Temple of Jala is in Berg. Speak to Priestess Themala there.
text.complete: Priestess Themala says, "Luisane sent you? Then welcome. Jala's songs are for anyone who will listen. Right-click me and choose Buy to see what I can teach you."

steps.objective: Speak to Priestess Themala at the Temple of Jala
